title: Row Scan Invariant
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean string, $B$ a natural-number register bound, $k$ an index site, and $q$ a rational number. For every natural number $dd$ and register state $\sigma$, suppose the value in the row register selected by $k$ minus the outer counter, with truncated natural subtraction, equals $dd$; every register is at most $B$; the outer counter is at most the selected row-register value, which is less than the vertex count $n$; the input pointer is $2n+2+2(an)$, where $a$ is the outer counter; the inner counter is at most $n$; and $2n+2+2n^2\le B$. If, for every $b'\le n$, the configuration at the next-row state with outer counter set to the selected row-register value, input pointer set to $2n+2+2(n\cdot\mathrm{row})$, and inner counter set to $b'$ has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $q$, then the configuration at the row-check state with register state $\sigma$ has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $q$.
hypotheses_covered: truncated difference of selected row register and outer counter equals $dd$
outer counter is at most the selected row register
selected row register is less than vertex count $n$
for every $b'\le n$, the specified next-row configuration has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $q$
replaced:
Fix a bit-string input $x$, a register bound $B$, an index site $k$, and a rational
number $q$. For every natural number $dd$ and register state $\sigma$, assume that the
row-register value minus the outer-counter value (with truncated natural subtraction)
equals $dd$, every register of $\sigma$ is at most $B$, the outer counter is at most the
row-register value, and the row-register value is less than the vertex count. Assume
also that the input pointer equals $2n+2+2(an)$, where $a$ and $n$ are the outer counter
and vertex count; the inner counter is at most $n$; and $2n+2+2n^2\le B$. If, for each
$b'\le n$, the configuration at the scan's next-row state with outer counter set to the
row-register value, pointer set to $2n+2+2(\mathrm{row}\cdot n)$, and inner counter set
to $b'$ has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $q$, then the
configuration at the scan's row-check state with register state $\sigma$ has
probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $q$.
